name: Shin Seiki Evan**lion: Midara
original_name: 新世紀エヴァン○リオン:淫
source:
The robot called E***gelion.
It has the shape of the human body, and looks like a giant in a fairy tale.
However, it doesn't have the gentle mind like in the old stories.

Assault the elite pilots, Rei Aya**mi, Asuka Langl*y Shiki**mi and Mari Illustrio*s Maki**mi! Take them to the world of pleasure and release your terror and frustration!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052038.html]DLSite English[/url]]
